errors.text_span: Стълбовете за „Преработваща промишленост“ са оцветени в червено
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims the bar for 'Преработваща промишленост' (Manufacturing industry) is red. In the chart, the red bar corresponds to 'ДОБИВНА ПРОМИШЛЕНОСТ' (Mining industry). Additionally, it incorrectly uses the plural 'Стълбовете' (bars) when only a single bar is colored red.

The description of the x-axis units is incomplete. The full unit on the axis is 'хил.лв./заето лице' (thousand BGN/person employed), but the description only states 'хиляди лева' (thousand BGN), omitting the 'per person employed' part from the axis label description.
